policy.replacement: none selected; unused artwork is deleted and required branding uses LibrePaint CC0 artwork
policy.new_white_content_license: not applicable while the replacement selection is empty
policy.preserved_metadata_and_container_content: Retains its existing license and provenance
policy.preserve_archives: Replace only the root preview.png payload while preserving ZIP entry order and metadata.
policy.preserve_embedded_raster_metadata: Retain PNG eXIf/iCCP/iTXt/tEXt/zTXt, JPEG EXIF/ICC/JUMBF/IPTC/COM, WebP EXIF/ICCP/XMP, and embedded PNG metadata in ICO/ICNS representations byte-for-byte.
policy.legal_wording_gate: No selected white raster asset contains embedded legal wording; the empty metadata inventory remains hash-checked and legal wording is never rewritten.
policy.scope_policy: Keep functional images under the most specific verified license, replace required branding with LibrePaint-owned CC0 artwork, and delete unused artwork instead of hiding or whitening it.

ios_image_audit.definition: An image is licensed linked art only when a parseable SVG or SVGZ has a cc:Work with a direct cc:license child whose rdf:resource is nonempty. White and zero-byte states take precedence in the exclusive final-state counts.

legal_metadata_audit.definition: Preserve each original embedded metadata chunk byte-for-byte for raster assets whose source metadata contains copyright, Creative Commons, or attribution/share-alike wording. The permanent gate is self-contained in this manifest and does not require Git history.

excluded.reason: Non-iOS-scope brush, texture, frame, and save-status artwork
